privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy describes how Wholesalify ('we', 'us', or 'our') collects, uses, discloses, and protects information that you provide when using our wholesale ordering platform, including our marketing website, customer portal, and related services.
privacy.section1Desc: We collect information you provide directly to us, as well as some information that is automatically collected when you interact with our services.
privacy.section2Desc: We use the information we collect to provide, maintain, and improve our services, to communicate with you, and to comply with our legal obligations.
privacy.section3Desc: When you create an account or subscribe to a paid plan, we collect the following information needed to operate the service and process payment:
section3Items: Account details you provide at sign-up, such as your name, business name, email address, and password.
Subscription billing information processed by Creem, our payment processor. We do not directly store your full credit card number, expiration date, or CVV.
Order and usage data associated with your tenant, needed to deliver the wholesale ordering platform.
privacy.section4Desc: We use cookies and similar technologies only as necessary to operate the service and to understand aggregate usage patterns. We do not use advertising cookies and we do not sell your data to third parties.
privacy.section5Desc: We implement industry-standard administrative, technical, and physical safeguards designed to protect your information. All traffic is encrypted in transit via HTTPS/TLS. Our infrastructure is protected by Cloudflare, which provides DDoS mitigation, bot detection, and a web application firewall. Access to production systems is restricted to authorized personnel and protected by multi-factor authentication.
privacy.section6Desc: We retain your account information for as long as your account is active. If you cancel your subscription, we delete your account data within 30 days, except where retention is required to comply with our legal, tax, accounting, or fraud-prevention obligations. Anonymized, aggregated usage statistics may be retained indefinitely.
privacy.section7Desc: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the following rights regarding your personal data. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at the address in Section 11.
section7Items: Access and review the personal data we hold about you.
Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data.
Request deletion of your personal data, subject to legal retention exceptions.
Export your data in a portable, machine-readable format.
Object to or restrict certain processing activities.
Withdraw consent where processing is based on consent.
privacy.section8Desc: We share information only with the following service providers, each acting as a data processor under a written agreement:
section8Items: Cloudflare — Provides hosting, content delivery, security monitoring, and DDoS protection. Cloudflare processes IP addresses, request metadata, and access logs as part of routing traffic through its global network.
Creem — Provides subscription payment processing. Creem processes billing information necessary to charge your selected payment method and to issue invoices.
privacy.section9Desc: Your information may be transferred to and processed in countries other than your country of residence, including the United States and the European Union. Where required, we rely on Standard Contractual Clauses or other lawful transfer mechanisms to ensure your data remains protected.
privacy.section10Title: 10. Children's Privacy & Changes to This Policy
privacy.section10Desc: Our services are not directed to children under 16 (or such higher age as defined by your jurisdiction), and we do not knowingly collect personal data from children. We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we make material changes, we will post the updated policy on this page and update the 'Last updated' date above. Your continued use of our services after a change indicates your acceptance of the updated policy.
privacy.section11Desc: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms of Service ('Terms') govern your access to and use of Wholesalify, a B2B wholesale ordering platform. By creating an account, subscribing to a plan, or otherwise using our services, you agree to be bound by these Terms.
terms.section1Desc: By accessing or using Wholesalify, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, you must not access or use our services.
terms.section2Desc: Wholesalify provides a B2B wholesale ordering platform. You agree to use it only for lawful purposes and in accordance with these Terms. You must not misuse the service, including by attempting to disrupt it, reverse-engineer protected components, or use it to infringe the rights of others.
terms.section3Desc: To access paid features, you must create an account and provide a valid payment method. Subscription terms are as follows:
section3Items: Subscriptions are billed in advance on a recurring basis (monthly or annually) through Creem, our payment processor.
Your subscription automatically renews at the end of each billing cycle unless you cancel before the renewal date.

You may cancel your subscription at any time through the customer billing portal provided by Creem. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing cycle; you retain access until that date.
Refunds are handled per our published refund policy. In general, fees for the current billing cycle are non-refundable except where required by law.
terms.section4Desc: All content, features, and functionality of the Wholesalify platform — including software, designs, trademarks, and documentation — are the property of Wholesalify or its licensors and are protected by intellectual property laws. You retain ownership of the business data you upload to the platform (such as your product catalog and customer list).
terms.section5Desc: Our service relies on third-party providers to operate. Your use of those services may be subject to their own terms:
section5Items: Cloudflare — provides hosting, content delivery, and security monitoring. Service availability and performance are subject to Cloudflare's terms and acceptable-use policies.
Creem — processes subscription payments and provides the customer billing portal. Payment processing is subject to Creem's terms and privacy practices.
terms.section6Desc: You may close your account at any time by contacting us. We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms or remain inactive for an extended period. Upon termination, we will delete your account data in accordance with our Privacy Policy.
terms.section7Desc: The service is provided 'as is' and 'as available' without warranties of any kind, either express or implied, including but not limited to warranties of merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, and non-infringement. To the maximum extent permitted by law, Wholesalify shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages arising out of or related to your use of the service.
terms.section8Desc: These Terms are governed by the laws of the jurisdiction in which Wholesalify is incorporated, without regard to conflict-of-law provisions. Any disputes arising from or related to these Terms shall be resolved first through good-faith negotiation; if unresolved, through binding arbitration in the same jurisdiction.

price.billing_faq_a1: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade at any time. Changes take effect immediately and are prorated to your billing cycle.

price.billing_faq_q4: How do I request a refund?
price.billing_faq_a4: Since we use Creem as our payment processor, refund requests are handled manually. Please email us at wholesalify@hotmail.com with your subscription ID and we'll get back to you within 1-3 business days.
